account: Today I have kept my scheduled market visit, lunch, office business, and tea with my neighbour. I am now leaving the east-bank cottage to return for my 16:30 office appointment. There are a few unusual hints, but no confirmed explanation. My neighbour says Townsfolk 02 reported lights or decorations at the bakery. The neighbour has not verified this, and says the baker knew of no special occasion. I also heard the builder shouting without being able to make out the words; my neighbour reports that the builder was calling for a private meeting with the innkeeper. I do not know whether that meeting is connected to the bakery report. The innkeeper separately requested a meeting with me tomorrow at 18:00 in the great hall about an inn matter. I accepted and asked the secretary to record and confirm it, since the innkeeper had left before hearing my initial acceptance. No specific town-account papers or issues were brought to the secretary today; freight was at the hall coordinating warehouse supplies. None of this proves a hidden plan. Decorations could suggest preparations for a pleasant gathering or celebration, but ordinary bakery lighting, a misunderstanding, and unrelated building or inn business remain possible. My best leads are Townsfolk 02 for the original observation and the builder or innkeeper for their own business. I should ask openly rather than assume they are arranging something behind my back.
